faq1_q: How long does the whole process take?
faq1_a: The questionnaire takes about 8 minutes. Once you click generate, the AI writes your report and the PDF downloads automatically in roughly 60 seconds.
faq2_q: Is the report actually personalised to my business?
faq2_a: Yes. The AI analyses your specific answers — business type, acquisition channels, sales process, and challenges — to write a report that applies directly to your situation. It is not a template.
faq3_q: Do I need to create an account or give my email?
faq3_a: No account needed. You fill in the questionnaire, pay via Stripe for the full audit, and the PDF downloads straight to your device. No login required.
faq4_q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq4_a: All major credit and debit cards via Stripe. Payments are processed in GBP on a fully PCI-compliant, SSL-secured checkout.
faq5_q: What if the PDF doesn't download?
faq5_a: Click the Download Again button which appears after generation. If the issue persists, contact us with your payment confirmation and we will resolve it manually.
faq6_q: Is my business data kept confidential?
faq6_a: Absolutely. Your answers are used solely to generate your report and are not stored or shared with any third parties. All data is transmitted over HTTPS.
